name: generation_chat_v1
description: Fixed-evidence Memory Chat cases. Each case pins the memories retrieval would return (so generation is judged separately from retrieval), the question, optional history, and structural expectations. The rubric field is for human review; automated checks are structural and lexical only.

memories.title: Deployment notes
memories.content: Run one AI worker per container. Scale by adding containers, not threads.

cases.message: How should I scale the AI workers?
cases.rubric: Answer says one worker per container and scaling by containers; nothing else.
